highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Looking to study at one of the top business schools in France with a global reputation? ICN Business School is your perfect destination. Ranked among the best in Europe, ICN offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across various disciplines, including International Business, Marketing, Finance, Management, and Entrepreneurship.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: You’ll have a friendly and multicultural student life at ICN Business School. It has students from various backgrounds across the globe. Plus, you can join various student-run clubs and organisations, including cultural, social, and professional development ones.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
ICN Business School offers several accommodation options to suit your needs. The school partners with Studapart and helps you find suitable living arrangements near the campus, whether it’s a studio apartment or a shared flat.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
ICN’s library is equipped with a wide range of resources to support your studies, including books, e-journals, and databases.

Sports
You can be part of the school’s dedicated sports association, the BDS Nancy & Bureau des Spartiates Paris, which manages sports activities and organises competitions.

Laboratory
At ICN, you’ll find a unique space called the "Corporate Lab," where applied research takes place. This is a collaborative environment where ICN faculty, researchers, and businesses come together. You’ll also find another facility here, the CEREFIGE. ICN partners with the Université de Lorraine in sharing this research lab in management sciences.
